working_title: The Tied Arm That Proved Your Blood Circulates
title: The Sum That Broke the Old Idea

chapter_card.text: The Sum That Broke the Old Idea
chapter_card.treatment: soft cross-fade after the last word + 0.6 s breath; music continues

open_stamp.treatment: Didot italic side label in the edit

set_language: Warm candlelit 17th-century world: dark oak, cream linen, brass, leather books, London fog. Body cutaways are clean, glowing illustrations (warm red arteries, cool blue veins), never anatomical gore. Say 'same 1616 London lecture room' or 'same Harvey study' for continuity; never 'same DNA'.
explorer_lock: ONE beat (plate 11): in Harvey's study the Explorer sets out a tiny jug for every heartbeat; the jugs fill the desk, spill onto the floor and march out of the door; he turns wide-eyed to the single loaf. Attach the Explorer reference.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; gore, wounds, blood on skin, cut flesh or real animal organs (animal hearts only as Harvey's ink drawings); live or dead animals on a table; lava drip / molten bead; underside lamp bulb or shade cup; unfinished flat cards; garbled writing; unfinished Explorer hair; DNA helix; readable text or logos baked into the plate (labels and the De Motu Cordis title are added in the edit); twin Explorer; faces in the first two seconds of the film. Never say 'same DNA' or 'lab DNA' in a Veo prompt.
always_fails: garbled card text or wrong sums (2 oz, 1/8, 1000 checked by hand)
unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
gore: wound, blood on skin, cut flesh, real animal organs
a face in the first two seconds of the film
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns.
quality_note: Flow Veo 3.1 on the Mac Mini CDP worker, benoats@googlemail.com only. Quality for anything with light (candles, glowing loop, stove heart) and every hero plate; Fast only for low-risk garnish. One plate at a time until the first KEEP; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
labels: White Didot italic side label, 1-4 words, one at a time, on the plate's first beat; added in the edit.

plates.vo_land: Picture yourself in his lecture room in London.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same 1616 London lecture room, cold and candlelit, oak panels, physicians on hard wooden benches; William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, at the front moves his pointer across a huge painted heart chart. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: It's cold, the candles are lit, and you're on a hard wooden bench.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Point of view from a back bench of the same lecture room: breath mists in the cold, candle flames shiver, Harvey small and bright at the front. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Harvey has spent years watching the slow hearts of cold-blooded animals, like frogs and eels, where each beat is easy to see.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Harvey's notebook on his desk: brown-ink drawings of the slow hearts of a frog and an eel with little sketch arrows; pages turn gently. Ink drawings only, no live animal, no readable text. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+4.5 s into) Harvey has spent years watching the slow hearts of cold-blooded animals, like frogs and eels, where each beat is easy to see.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same notebook page: the ink drawing of the heart gently squeezes and relaxes on the paper, slow and easy to see. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The little glowing stove-heart from the cutaway cools and turns into a strong, clean cartoon heart muscle that squeezes firmly. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Each squeeze pushes blood out into the arteries, and that push is the pulse you feel in your wrist.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway: the cartoon heart squeezes and with each squeeze a ripple of warm red races down an artery in the arm to the wrist, where two fingertips feel it beat. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Then he asks how much blood each squeeze pushes out.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same Harvey study by candlelight: William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, dips his quill and looks from a drawing of the heart to a blank page, thinking. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Say the left side of the heart holds about two ounces.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Close on the page: Harvey's quill writes '2 oz' in large clear brown ink. The numbers stay sharp and correct. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Say just one eighth of that goes out with each beat.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same page: the quill writes '1/8' under '2 oz' in large clear brown ink. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: In half an hour, a heart beats more than a thousand times.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same page: the quill writes '1000' under the other numbers in large clear brown ink; a brass clock ticks beside the page. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same Harvey study. Exactly ONE Explorer, on model: a young boy, messy wavy brown hair (full crown), round thin gold glasses, long teal coat, tan waistcoat, brown bow tie, satchel. He acts, then leaves. He sets out a tiny pewter jug for every heartbeat; the jugs fill the desk, spill onto the floor and march in a line out of the door; he turns, wide-eyed, to a single loaf of bread on the table. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame.

Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A tower of tiny red jugs rises beside a simple glowing outline of a human body that holds far less; the tower keeps growing past it. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+3.5 s into) Because if the liver made all that blood fresh from food, you'd have to eat more than your own weight every single day.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A brass balance scale: on one pan a mountain of bread and food, on the other a simple wooden figure of a person; the food pan sinks and keeps sinking. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: And if the body used it all up, where would it go?
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A glowing outline of a body: red drains out of its limbs and vanishes into nothing, leaving a faint question in the air (no letters). Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: There's only one answer that works.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same Harvey study: William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, lifts his quill, the candle brightens on his face as the idea lands. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: The heart pumps it out through the arteries, and it comes back through the veins, round and round.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Clean glowing cutaway: the same red stream leaves the heart through the arteries and comes back to it through blue veins, round and round, a glowing loop. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same glowing loop, seen whole on a simple body outline; the stream speeds up and runs steadily round. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+3.7 s into) We now know he was being very careful: your heart pumps all of your blood round your body in about a minute.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same glowing loop with a brass clock hand sweeping once round the circle as a single glowing drop completes one lap. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same Harvey study: William Harvey, a short man of about forty, olive skin, black hair to the collar, small pointed black beard and moustache, dark keen eyes, black physician's gown with a plain white falling collar, looks from his page of sums to a strip of cream linen on the desk and picks it up. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
